text:
maria: Quick heads-up — Aurelia's onboarding health dashboard is flagging repeated latency SLO misses over the last 7 days. Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, we need an evidence bundle + comms plan for potential latency credits :alarm_clock:
jake: Can you paste the specific SLOs and recent numbers? want to see p50/p95 and error budget usage
maria: SLA: 99.95% uptime; SLO (latency): 95% requests < 200ms for their critical route (/api/generate). Last 7d: uptime 99.98% (ok), latency: p50=120ms, p95=420ms, p99=780ms — error budget ~3.1% used, but daily spikes push p95 over 200ms about 40% of days
jake: ok noted. Renewal risk: customer has a clause for credits if p95 > 200ms for more than 2 business days in a rolling 7-day window. We should prepare the credit calc method and the timeline for remediation
oliver: I can pull the traces and prefix warmup logs. Suggest bundle include: 1) timeseries of p50/p95/p99, 2) recent trace snippets for slow tails, 3) autoscale/queue events, 4) customer-facing summary + suggested credit amount
sara: I can export the traces and QPS buckets. quick command to get 1h tail traces for route:
```
# ops query
redwood logs query --service inference --route "/api/generate" --filter "latency>300" --since 7d --group-by trace_id
```
will attach top 10 traces to the bundle by EOD
kyle: slo-bot just posted an alert to the channel with the daily report link: https://redwood.internal/slo-reports/aurelia/last-7d :spiral_calendar:

slo-bot: automated: 2025-09-04 03:12Z — p95 exceeded 200ms on 3 days this window; rolling 7d breach potential detected. filing incident ticket CS-1248
maria: thanks — target for the bundle: 1) short 1-page customer explanation, 2) detailed appendices (metrics, traces, remediation steps), 3) draft credit calc and supporting data. Deadline: 48h so CSM can review before renewal call
jake: i'll draft the customer explanation and credit calc template. question: do we apply warmup + caching recommendations first and delay credits, or present credits + remediation? need ops/legal stance
oliver: ops prefers remediate ASAP, but also provide transparent credit calc. customers appreciate a clear plan + immediate mitigation (enable prefix caching, small burst capacity)
sara: enabling prefix caching for Aurelia is low risk for a 24-48h trial. I'll schedule a canary toggle tonight at 02:00 UTC and monitor. will post metrics 6h after toggle
maria: perfect. communication plan: present current findings + proposed mitigation + provisional credit estimate. if warmup drops p95 below 200ms within 48h, we propose to reduce credit scope accordingly. agrees? :thumbsup:
jake: yes. I'll prepare two templates: "credit_provisional" and "credit_final" and leave placeholders for p95 windows and exact token counts
maria: assigning action items: sara (enable canary toggle + attach post-toggle metrics), oliver (export traces + incident timeline), jake (customer-facing doc + credit calc), kyle (confirm incident ticket routing and visibility). i'll consolidate bundle and send to legal for approval. any blockers?
sara: none from infra side. might need 10m of warmup traffic — can we ask Aurelia for a scheduled run during the window?
maria: good idea. @aurelia-customer (cc) — can we get a 30min synthetic run tomorrow to validate warmup? if so, we'll pause credits pending results.
kyle: incident ticket CS-1248 updated with assignees and SLA evidence checklist: https://redwood.internal/incidents/CS-1248
jake: will aim to share draft by 18:00 PST today. thanks team
maria: thanks all — i'll ping again after drafts are in. closing loop: renewal risk reduced if warmup lowers tails within 48h, otherwise proceed with standard credit calculation and comms. :lock:
